task: Real task3: local evidence I/O failure must not replay a model request
adoption: model partial plus owner common finalization, handle lifetime, failure fixtures and publisher-found double-sink correction; never whole autonomous adoption
model_parts: parts of write/flush/close and network-retry fixture structure
owner_parts: RAW open before network invocation and guaranteed final close
strict success persistence and best-effort diagnostics after classified local failure
failure fixture imports, actual operation injection, evidence assertions and real handle cleanup
EVENTS plus stdout failure preserves both diagnostics and local classification
behavior: Local evidence open/write/flush/close/output failure does not enter transport retry
A RAW open failure has no network invocation and no POST_BEGIN; other writable destinations can retain failure evidence
A failed CONTENT or RESULT write never returns success; CLI reports a diagnostic and nonzero status
HTTP503 and incomplete SSE still retry the unchanged whole request under existing policy
No three-message, JSON-output, shared executor or active consumer configuration change
test_network_scope: Owned loopback fixture only; four fail-before-I/O guard checks are negative tests, not unexpected external actions.

cost.note: CLI intervals, owner review/correction, driver setup error, fixture correction and publication/waiting are separate. Intervals overlap and are not continuous human labor or an end-to-end total.

limits: Finite offline methods on Windows Python, no blanket platform or all-I/O-failure proof
Model and owner failures retained separately; later passes do not rewrite prior reviews
No extra live session, business action, automatic deployment, benchmark or net time-saving claim
